snippet.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii: New Horizons Trailer
snippet.description:
Uploading the mod's trailer as a standalone video rather than as a part of Mone's Modding Direct (https://youtu.be/fhjTXwBap6Q?feature=shared).
Hope you enjoy!

This is the trailer for New Super Mario Bros. Wii: New Horizons, a NSMBW mod that aims to add new levels and worlds to the New Super Mario Bros. Wii story by serving as a direct sequel of sorts. It began development in 2023 and has been going off strong since then. I had been working on it personally together with @matyssey.

The mod's story is as follows:
Right after defeating Bowser and leaving his castle, Mario and his friends are stopped dead in their tracks by Bowser Jr. and Kamek, who end up kidnapping the princess in a last ditch effort. Mario and the others decide to hop into a nearby warp cannon to get a head start on the two, but the warp cannon malfunctions, sending them flying into uncharted territory. It's now up to them to make their way through these new unexplored worlds in order to stop Bowser Jr. and Kamek.

If you like what you're seeing and want to see more of it, I suggest subscribing in order not to miss out on any updates.
You can also head to the Horizon discord server (https://discord.com/invite/Quvaj2Ufhb) to check out the mod's thread!

Thanks for watching!
